text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! Sweep Tosho!
Sweep Tosho makes a sudden surge!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho crosses the finish line in first!
Claiming the glory of the Shuka Sho is
Sweep Tosho!!
(WOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap... That's insaaane!!
I've never seen such a wild, valiant, sparks-flying generation before in my life...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And the one who beat all those girls was Sweep Tosho...!!
Did you see that final burst of speed!? How was that even...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, she said it, didn't she?
That she'd change the world and rewrite common sense.
Just maybe—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Yeah, maybe...
If it's Sweep Tosho...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(It was... fun. So much fun...!
And what's more—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Those eyes! The crowd's gaze is different than before! That's right, so this must mean...!)

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah, I lost!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
! Aha... that's right.
It's my win!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong, are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kh, of course I'm crying! Because it's so frustrating!!
Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was pretty annoyed with you at first.
Like, don't act as if you're the sole
representative of the Triple Tiara all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I already knew that much.
...So? What about now?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I guess I'm still feeling a bit annoyed.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Wait a second—!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, I acknowledge it.
...Out of all of us, you were the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"So, act like a proper representative and go.
Go on and change the world already."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Our little witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *chomp, munch munch*... *chomp*.

Having conquered the Shuka Sho, she achieved a record
truly worthy of being called this year's representative
of the Triple Tiara circuit.

Her selfish streak is still going strong, however.
On our way back, she suddenly blurted out, "I wanna eat ice cream!" and while keeping her company—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Puha. ...Anyway, about what's next!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What, were you zoning out?
That's why you're failing as a familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pull yourself together!!
—We're so close to perfecting our racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"To make the magic of racing stronger, I'll run in even more special races."
That was the resolve that brought me this far, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: We planted the seeds during the Oka Sho and the interviews that followed. And at the Oaks, those seeds sprouted beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was so much fun seeing the passion burning bright in everyone running in the race—
and a magical spell was cast on Rob Roy alone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"And at the Shuka Sho... you saw it, right?!
I bet at least half the people there were completely under my spell!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You know, I think I'm starting to understand
what makes a race truly special."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course, like you said, the race itself being "special"
is important too. It has to be a stage that everyone's dying to watch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, on top of that—there are two more things.
Two things you definitely need!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
One is a "special rival"!
You've got to have someone you can clash passionately with, just like those girls with the light blue ribbons.
choice_data_list: I see... And what's the other one?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"The other is that
'I myself am special.'"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Like the girl getting tons of attention after declaring magic in her interview.
...Or the frontrunner for this year's Triple Tiara, for instance."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: On a special grand stage, against special rivals, the absolute most special me will take them on!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's bound to be the most fun race ever, and if that gets the magic inside me totally maxed out—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I know for sure that I can cast magic over the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —No, I'm gonna put it on the line!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That is why, familiar,
we are entering the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just being the representative of this year's Triple Tiara route
isn't enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become even more special.
—By taking on the girls in the Senior Class
who ran the Triple Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
For me,
Classic Class or Senior Class doesn't matter!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become the representative of every single Umamusume on the Triple Tiara route!

Sweep Tosho made her selfish demand
with a defiant, triumphant huff.

At times like that, she was always
more stubborn, willful, and obstinate than anyone...
choice_data_list: Alright, next up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
Alright, next up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.text: —And that she is the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All set!!
Alright, let's head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back, you have to work!!
Work your fingers to the bone for my sake♪
